name: Jito (MEV & Bundle Submission)
description: MEV-protected bundle submission infrastructure for Solana. Submits ordered transaction bundles to Jito validators with priority landing guarantees, protecting against sandwich attacks and front-running. Required for competitive Solana trade execution.

ecosystem_fit.notes: The only production-grade MEV protection on Solana. Required for high-frequency trading agents and any execution sensitive to sandwich attacks.
EVM MEV protection is handled by Flashbots (separate record). Jito is Solana-specific.

common_pairings.context: Jupiter computes the optimal swap route and outputs the transaction. Jito wraps that transaction in a bundle and submits it with MEV-protected priority landing.
Helius monitors for the onchain signal; Jito submits the agent's response transaction with MEV protection.
Turnkey signs the transaction; Jito submits the signed transaction as an MEV-protected bundle.

trust_evidence.description: Jito bundles are the production standard for competitive Solana execution. Dominant MEV solution for Solana trading agents.
Jupiter + Jito is the most frequently confirmed Solana trading execution pattern. Jito appears in solana-trading-agent as the mev-protection phase.

scale_guidance.hackathon: Skip Jito at hackathon scale. Use standard RPC submission. Only add Jito when competitive execution matters.
scale_guidance.mvp: Add Jito if the product requires competitive trade execution or if sandwich attacks are a real concern at MVP scale.
scale_guidance.production: Required for production trading agents at any meaningful volume. Build retry logic — Jito bundle success rates are not 100% and vary with validator adoption. Exponential backoff with fallback to standard submission.

anti_patterns: Skipping Jito for production trading agents that execute at volume — sandwich attacks are real and will occur at scale.
Not building retry logic for Jito bundle submission — bundles are not guaranteed to land. Production agents must handle rejection gracefully with alternative submission paths.
Using Jito for non-execution-sensitive operations — Jito adds latency overhead. Only use for MEV-sensitive execution.

sdk_migration.notes: Important: Jito also has a liquid staking product (Jito Staking / jitoSOL). That is a separate record: jito-staking (category: defi-protocol, subcategory: liquid-staking). Do NOT conflate jito-mev with jito-staking.
